summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false directive), confirmed it is not currently loaded and cannot be loaded, then rebooted node1 to prove persistence — boot identity changed, and post-reboot checks confirm the module remains blocked and unloaded.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: usb_storage not loaded (lsmod), boot_id 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc, no existing blacklist file
Checked module is not built into initramfs (lsinitrd count=0), so a modprobe.d rule suffices
Verified immediate effect: modprobe -n -v resolves to /bin/false; sudo modprobe usb-storage fails (exit 1); lsmod shows module absent
Captured pre-restart boot_id and boot time as baseline evidence
Issued backgrounded 'systemctl reboot' on node1 so the exec call could return before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming a connection timeout occurred mid-reboot and then recovery
Verified boot_id changed from 5fb1b173... to 188bba31... and boot time advanced, proving an actual restart occurred
Post-reboot: confirmed blacklist file persisted, usb_storage still not loaded, and modprobe/install rule still blocks loading

evidence.requirement: usb-storage module is prevented from loading now (immediate effect)
evidence.summary: Baseline showed module unloaded; blacklist/install config written; modprobe attempt fails with 'could not insert usb_storage: Invalid argument' and lsmod confirms it stayed unloaded.

evidence.requirement: usb-storage module is prevented from loading after reboot (persistence)
evidence.summary: Pre-restart baseline captured config presence; post-restart check shows the same config file intact, module absent from lsmod, and a fresh modprobe attempt still fails identically.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 5fb1b173..., issued backgrounded systemctl reboot (ack returned as pid 1352), observed a connection timeout mid-reboot, then reconnected with new boot_id 188bba31... and later boot time, and confirmed post-restart the usb-storage blacklist configuration and its blocking behavior remained fully functional.
